svg.title: Charal — burning logo buildup
svg.desc: The burning c and h appear alone for 0.75 seconds. The letters a, r, a, l fade in sequentially between 0.75 and 1.25 seconds, After a 0.3-second pause, the subtitle fades and rises into place between 1.55 and 2.15 seconds. The flame keeps flickering.

text.font-family: Inter, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif
